findings.desc: doc-code-drift: proofstory slicing surface is internally inconsistent. docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md lines 419-431 still say the initial MVP only reports proofstory_gate_check --dryRun and that durable slice plans are future parent-child orchestration, but lines 967-1080 list slice_plan_set, parent_ledger_rollup_set, slice-plan.json, and parent-ledger-rollup.json as implemented MVP artifacts. Align the earlier slicing section with the bounded implemented slicing surface while preserving the no-auto-child-story claim.
